title: access.json grants
description: The grants whose subject is the person (table grants), revoked ones included: target, level, capabilities, reason, who granted it and when, the expiry and the revocation. Grants to a group of the person belong to the group and are not listed; the groups appear under group_memberships. Targets appear by ID only.

target_kind.description: Kind of the target the grant applies to.

target_id.description: ID of the space, channel or host; absent for the instance.

level.description: Access level; absent on a host, where levels do not apply.

capabilities.description: Additional capabilities of the grant, possibly none.

reason.description: Reason given when the grant was created.

granted_by.description: ID of the principal who created the grant.

expires_at.description: End of validity; absent when the grant does not expire.

revoked_at.description: When the grant was revoked; absent while it is not revoked.

revoked_by.description: ID of the principal who revoked the grant; absent when it is not revoked or the server revoked it (for example on an account deletion).

revoke_reason.description: Reason of the revocation; absent when none was given.
